Scope Gate.rationale: scope-definition validated 33/33; 9 in-scope items, 6 exclusions, 21 criteria, 0 blocking questions. Q-001 resolved by operator default: success = at least 3 of 6 implement-feature phases dispatched at a non-deep tier. omn-product-owner produced the evidence and is excluded from deciding.

Planning Gate.rationale: execution-plan validated 45/45: 14 tasks, 9 waves, 23 edges, 7 risks attached to tasks, 2 non-blocking questions left to the design phase. One attempt rejected offline and corrected before completion (T-014 criteria, external-edge naming). planner produced the evidence and is excluded from deciding.

Design Gate.rationale: technical-design validated 78/78; option O-001 (config file model-tier-policy.json) selected over registry-field runner-up, re-derivable from the option table; D-001/D-002 decision records accepted at this gate. Open items resolved by operator: UQ-1 accept execution-planning at standard (3 of 6 non-deep, no margin, recorded as accepted risk); UQ-2 host alias values for implementation to declare in config only: light=haiku, standard=inherit, deep=opus; UQ-3 verifier baseline compared by pass/fail not check count; UQ-4 no operator override switch (out of scope). architect produced the evidence and is excluded from deciding.

Review Gate.rationale: review-package validated 31/31, verdict approve-with-corrections: 0 critical, 0 high, 1 medium (F-001), 2 low (F-002, F-003), 0 blocking. All three closed by a post-review correction pass by omn-dev-1-implement and re-verified by the operator: tests.test_model_tier + tests.test_bundled_payload 58 OK, verify_registry_coverage 8/8, verify_validators 6/6, verify_manifests 2/2. Review also corrected the implementation report's claim that M6 fails (it passes; it only failed while this run was in progress); X1 and S8 reproduce on a clean HEAD export and are pre-existing. omn-dev-2-reviewer produced the evidence and is excluded from deciding.

Verification Gate.rationale: Full unit suite 642 of 642 OK on the corrected tree (executed by the operator, 1586s); verify_registry_coverage 8/8, verify_validators 6/6, verify_manifests 2/2; the review independently reproduced 595 OK on HEAD and 638 on the changed tree. Pre-existing failures X1 and S8 reproduce on a clean HEAD export and are carried as open items; M6 passes. omn-dev-2-reviewer produced the evidence and is excluded from deciding.

Closure Gate.rationale: Six phases executed, six artifacts validated by their registered validators, five prior gates decided by non-producing owners. One charged retry: documentation attempt 1 (tier light, haiku) rejected on R1 and automatically escalated to standard, which is the feature's own escalation path observed live. Release note verdict released, 8 known issues recorded with owners. Operator-chosen defaults recorded: success bar 3 of 6 phases non-deep; operator decides gates. omn-documentation produced the evidence and is excluded from deciding.
